name: ASA FOETIDA
key_symptoms: Great difficulty in bringing up wind. Flatulence and regurgitation of liquid. Hysterical flatulence. Great distention. Sensation of emptiness and weakness, with distention and beating in stomach and abdomen. Forcible eructation of gas. Pulsation in pit of stomach. Violent gastralgia; cutting and burning in stomach and region of diaphragm. Gurgling and rolling of wind, which escapes afterwards with loud and difficult eructation.
Spasmodic tightness, as if lungs could not be fully expanded. Palpitation more like a tremor.
Bones.--Darting pain and caries in bones. Periosteum painful, swollen, enlarged. Ulcers affecting bones; thin, ichorous pus.
Irritable; complains of her troubles; sensitive. Boring above eyebrows. Pressive pain from within outward.
